links.note: Was on 32877 The Mahabharata's Regions, which covers only one of the eight statements. 32882 is the concept that holds this exact true-or-false exercise - the Rig Veda describing the entire geography of India, the Vishnu Purana describing the entire subcontinent, Jambudvipa in Ashoka's time, Hindustan first appearing in a Greek inscription, Hindu as a religious term in ancient Persian, and Bharata as a foreign name - and the statements run across the whole chapter.

Was on 32879 Bharat, Bharatam and the Constitution, which is about the Indian names and has nothing on the Greeks. Indike is the Greek name given in 32880, where the ancient Greeks named the region Indoi or Indike from the Persian Hindu.
